relationship_reviews.finding: Same reported creator Andrnator, but metadata identifies Gorgany/Doboshanka in 2010 and Pip Ivan/Chornohora in 2013; inspected rock faces differ. No specific shared capture established. Both retained, without an independence assertion.

Same creator Acabashi, but metadata identifies a Broadstairs pub wall on 2016-08-06 and a St Peters Road wall on 2016-08-11; inspected wall structures differ. bsp-0044 is visually rejected and only bsp-0045 retained. Author boilerplate mentions normal upstream RAW conversion, optimization and possible cropping; no alternate crop asset is identified in this inventory.
Sergiu Dumitriu Toronto painted surfaces from 2012-05-20, 10:43–11:04. Only 0068 retained; 0109 excluded as probable related capture after visual acceptance, the others rejected visually.
Dwight Burdette pond scenes from Michigan, 2012-05-25 through 2012-06-12, with different named roads. All rejected visually; no related candidate enters the inputs.
Ronja Addams-Moring, same Sipoo locality/date 2007-08-10 and bloom descriptions. Only 0135 visually accepted; 0145 rejected as contextual pond scene. No second related capture enters.

Rhetos captions explicitly link the same Wangerooge location across different years. Captions say two years while reported dates are 2023/2022; uncertainty retained. Only 0148 visually accepted; 0149 is a detached hand-held object and rejected.

Supplied thematic-category flag checked. 0183 is Rookuzz, 2006-07-11; 0184 is Stiopa, 2025-07-19, with different visible car surfaces. Only 0183 accepted; no relationship asserted from a shared category.

Si Griffiths. 0076/0078 same red/gray wooden surface sequence 12 seconds apart in 2009; 0078 excluded. 0074 and 0096 are reported 2005-04-16 and 2005-04-17 and show different corrugated/flat surfaces. No specific shared physical object established for those retained images; photographer reuse alone is not an exclusion.
ImagePerson: Ottawa paper mill 2014-12-11 and abandoned building 2015-06-25. No specific shared surface established; both retained, without an independence assertion.

Georges Grondin via public-domain-image.com. Different inspected paint boundaries; capture dates and locations unknown. No specific shared surface established; different images are not proof of independence.

Pink Sherbet / D Sharon Pruitt: 0061 reports 2011-03-26 and 0091 2012-01-05; different inspected surfaces. 0107 visually rejected for linear streaks. Artist hyperlinks identify same account; attribution request preserved. No specific shared surface established between the two retained images.

Both credit NPS/NPGallery, with distinct NPGallery asset UUIDs and different inspected water surfaces; 0142 capture date unknown, 0143 reports 2016-05-21. Agency reuse alone does not establish a common capture; both retained with unknown individual photographers.

Acabashi: Broadstairs wall in 2016 and Hatfield Broad Oak tank in 2018 are different stated settings and inspected materials. 0066 excluded relative to 0046 as probable related outing. No specific shared object between 0045 and 0046 established.

limitations: Commons statements are retained, not independently authenticated. Missing individual authors, dates and locations remain unknown. Exact identities and inspected evidence cannot prove capture independence. Known/probable relationships excluded conservatively; no expected matching pairs.
